notes.title: Giveaway CItadale: the results!
notes.content:
Hi!

The giveaway for Citadale ended. 

If you didn't win, don't be sad! Follow us on Twitter, where we will do other giveaways; if you want to support the developer in his love for Castlevania games, don't hesitate to buy the game, even in promotion :)

Twitter: https://twitter.com/RealEzekielRage

And now, the winners are .......... 

- FCKundo  https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198066495904
- Rafael Bzinho  https://steamcommunity.com/id/BzinhoGames
- Zio  https://steamcommunity.com/id/KaelZio
- goldgriffin360  https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198024724742
- Borg.Cubist  https://steamcommunity.com/id/borgcubist


Add me as a friend (or I'll add you, but I'm the slow type) in Steam in order to give you your key.

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a new update for the game has just been released. 

What's new?
- Added a double check for boss rooms in the second Chapter
- Tweaked enemy placement even further
- Finetuned the hit detection even more
- Some graphical upgrades in the backgrounds

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Citadale - The Legends Trilogy has been recently updated. 

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in keyboard mode that stopped a cutscene
[*]Added save states: Press F1 or the left analog stick to save a state and press F2 or the right analog stick to load a savestate. 
[i]Note: Savestates are universal so it's ONE savestate for all three chapters![/i][/list]
